scope: Constrain retained experimental interfaces and repair Gaussian validation/device caching. Synthetic CPU validation only; no upstream Villa edits, model/training/probability-recipe changes, trained volumetric detector, real-data accuracy claim or GPU measurement.

scope_decision.GaussianBlender: Maintained regional float32 window; positive finite weights and parameters, per-resolved-device cache. Default arithmetic unchanged.
scope_decision.VillaTTAWrapper: Retained experimental scalar-field adapter using pinned upstream algorithms. Validate batch/rank for all views and input/output grid for batched mirroring; retain sequential/coarser output behavior and custom callback timing. Current mixed ink/fiber/global-QC serving uses the existing regional path.
scope_decision.VolumetricInkHead: Retained untrained shape example; require declared channels/depth. Class/conv3d parameter names, valid convolution and gradients unchanged. CLI labels logits and uses a small random demo.
scope_decision.resnet3d_i3d: Retain existing training-only names and inference rejection. No reconstruction/adoption added.

validation_details: 2D/3D scalar fields, mirroring/axis transpose, batched/sequential and homogeneous multi-task results match the unchanged pinned implementation exactly.
Sequential coarser grids, custom callback order, channel-concatenated return type, model state-dict names and typed OOM fallback are preserved.
Malformed equal-numel grids, changed batches, global/nonspatial heads, mixed project task ranks, invalid options and input shapes fail explicitly.
Gaussian invalid inputs/underflow fail before caching; valid windows remain positive/symmetric/peak-normalized. Implicit CUDA cache routing is exercised with mocks only.
Volumetric dimensions, negative logits, gradients, training-only architecture dispatch and accurate CLI/help behavior are covered.
